text: 3. In cinematic portrayals of the ancient world, the iron-clad legionnaires of the (Answer) are often depicted as clanking, slow-moving tanks who would be pinned down by their own defensive plating. However, empirical archaeology reveals that this iconic Roman harness actually weighed significantly less than the standard equipment carried by a 21st-century firefighter entering a burning building. By distributing its mass across the shoulders and torso, it allowed for a range of motion that defies the "tin can" stereotype. What is the specific name of this overlapping plate armor?
Chain mail is what comes to mind
